statements.status_notes: Apache Airflow 3.3.2 makes the Core API logout endpoint revoke every credential the request presents, including an Authorization bearer token, instead of only the _token cookie (https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72649, backported to the 3.3 line in https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/72933; announcement https://lists.apache.org/thread/k9z1p0q1ng8m68nlnv9d1fqzscrfm7vr). Each of the 110 airflow packages published for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository (3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-14, amd64 and arm64) was placed by what it installs, read from the package's own file list and md5sums: 3.3.0-0 to 3.3.0-3 install apache-airflow-core 3.3.0 and 3.3.1-0 to 3.3.1-15 install 3.3.1, and lack the fix; 3.3.2-0 to 3.3.2-19 install 3.3.2 and 3.4.0-0 to 3.4.0-14 install 3.4.0. In the unpacked 3.3.2-0 and 3.4.0-0 packages, airflow/api_fastapi/core_api/security.py defines collect_request_tokens and the logout route in routes/public/auth.py revokes each token it returns; neither is in the unpacked 3.3.0-0 and 3.3.1-1 packages. Every other build's copy of those files has the same md5 as the unpacked build of its Airflow release, on both architectures. 3.3.2-0 is the first published package with the fix.
